operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md. Pause workflow triggers and outbound work; retain the exact source and private settings, export installation data with rer export, restore with rer import into fresh empty resources, then run owner setup and compare a new export before resuming. Preserve applied migration names and exact SQL bytes. Restored workflows stay inactive until the owner reconnects providers and reviews publication.
